scope: DW-11 Layer A — procedure-header unresolved references reach the index

issues.summary: The procedure-scoped dedup loop used bodyKeys.Add(DedupKey(item)), which deduplicates WITHIN the new feed as well as against the body-only feed; distinct unresolved links of a chained member access in a header (Foo.Bar vs Foo.Bar.Baz) share (module,procedure,line,column,reason) and one was silently dropped, recreating an undercount inside Layer A.
issues.resolution: Demonstrated real (member-access provenance anchors at the chain start): added pin LayerA_ChainedHeaderUnresolvedRefs_AllReachIndex_NoIntraFeedDrop which was RED against R1 code. Fix: (1) non-mutating dedup — seed bodyKeys once from the FunctionClassification items and test !bodyKeys.Contains(...), never adding procedure-scoped keys back (dedup only against the body-only set, never intra-feed); (2) strengthened DedupKey to include SurroundingText (the member/identifier name), which both feeds derive from the same AST node via the same ExtractName switch, so the same body ref still suppresses (no double-count) while distinct chain links survive. Re-validated: 912/912 Pipeline.Tests green (pin now green), COM golden gate byte-identical.

rounds.note: Confirmed Contains fully closes the intra-feed drop (even repeated-name chains like Foo.Bar.Bar keep both links); adding SurroundingText creates no double-count hole since both feeds compute the name from the same node via the same logic; no new determinism issue (suppression no longer order-dependent).
